column2: 夜間照不到地面的燈具

column2: 未連結路口的訊號燈頭

column1: The map uses an object (.sco) that is not installed. The game leaves it out. Install the mod it comes from, or delete the object. A junction of openMapper's whose file is gone (the map was moved without it) is made again for its roads with "Fix".
column2: 地圖使用了未安裝的物件（.sco）。遊戲會略去它。請安裝其來源的 mod，或刪除該物件。若 openMapper 的某個路口其檔案已不存在（地圖被搬走時沒有一起搬），可用「修正」為其道路重新建立。

column1: The map uses a road or spline type (.sli) that is not installed: that road is missing in the game, and buses cannot drive there.
column2: 地圖使用了未安裝的道路或樣條線類型（.sli）：該道路在遊戲中不存在，巴士無法行駛。

column1: An object or road names a picture that cannot be found. It will look white or black in the game.
column2: 物件或道路指向找不到的圖片。在遊戲中會顯示為白色或黑色。

column1: Two road ends lie on one another but are not joined. Traffic still finds its way (the game joins lanes by their ends), but rows of lamps and posts and the road's texture do not run on across, and the editor does not treat them as one road. "Join" links them.
column2: 兩條道路的端點重疊但未接合。交通仍可找到去路（遊戲按端點接合車道），但一排燈柱、支柱及道路貼圖不會接續，編輯器亦不視其為同一條道路。可用「接合」連結它們。

column1: A spline says it goes on into another one that no longer exists. "Fix" forgets that link.
column2: 某樣條線指向另一條已不存在的樣條線。可用「修正」忘記該連結。

column1: A bus stop belongs to the lane it stands beside (within about 25 m). This one has none near, so buses cannot stop at it. Move it next to the road, or "Fix" puts it at the kerb of the nearest lane (within 80 m).
column2: 巴士站屬於它旁邊的車道（約 25 米內）。此站附近沒有車道，巴士無法停靠。請將它移至路旁，或用「修正」把它放到最近車道的路緣（80 米內）。

column1: A start point is where the bus appears. This one is away from any lane: fine in a depot yard, otherwise the bus starts off the road.
column2: 起點是巴士現身的位置。此起點遠離所有車道：在車廠範圍內尚可，否則巴士會從路面以外出發。

column1: A start point refers to an object that was deleted. "Fix" removes the start point.
column2: 起點指向已刪除的物件。可用「修正」移除該起點。

column1: There is nowhere for the bus to appear. Place a start point (Game logic > Start points) on a road, or "Fix" puts one on a lane some 40 m before a bus stop.
column2: 巴士沒有現身的位置。請在道路上放置起點（「遊戲邏輯 > 起點」），或用「修正」在巴士站前約 40 米的車道上放置一個。

column1: Two things on the map share one IDCode: links, timetables and start points may pick the wrong one.
column2: 地圖上兩項內容共用同一 IDCode：連結、時刻表與起點可能會選錯。

column1: The counter for new IDCodes is below codes already used, so new objects would get codes twice. "Fix" raises it.
column2: 新 IDCode 的計數器低於已使用的編號，令新物件會有重複的編號。可用「修正」提高它。

column1: An object standing on the ground lies outside its own tile. The game does not show it. Move it a little or put it again.
column2: 站在地面上的物件位於其自身圖塊之外。遊戲不會顯示它。請略為移動或重新放置。

column1: global.cfg lists tiles whose file is not there. The game leaves them out; they stay listed, as start points and timetables count tiles by their place in the list.
column2: global.cfg 列出了檔案不存在的圖塊。遊戲會略去它們，但清單上仍保留，因為起點與時刻表按清單中的位置計算圖塊。

column1: A tile has no height file: its ground is flat. Saving writes one.
column2: 某圖塊沒有高度檔：其地面是平的。儲存時會寫出一個。

column1: No way along the roads was found through this trip's stops, so buses cannot drive it. Open it in Map > Lines and timetable to see where it breaks.
column2: 無法沿道路找到經過此班次各車站的路徑，巴士不能行駛。請在「地圖 > 路線與時刻表」開啟以找出中斷之處。

column1: A tour (a bus's day on the line) has no trips, so no bus runs it.
column2: 行車周期（巴士在該路線的一天）沒有班次，因此沒有巴士執行。

column1: A tour names no depot or group of the AI lists (or one that is not there): the game has no vehicle to send on it. Choose a depot for it in the Lines window, or "Fix" gives it the map's depot (one of OMSI 2's MAN buses added where the map has none).
column2: 行車周期未指定車廠或 AI 清單中的群組（或指定的並不存在）：遊戲沒有車輛可派。可在「路線」視窗為它選擇車廠，或用「修正」給它地圖的車廠（在地圖沒有車廠時，新增 OMSI 2 的一架 MAN 巴士）。

column1: The unscheduled traffic names a group that the AI lists do not have: those cars never appear. Add the group in Map > Traffic and AI, or "Fix" copies it from OMSI 2's own maps where they have it.
column2: 無預設班次的交通指定了 AI 清單中沒有的群組：那些汽車永不出現。請在「地圖 > 交通與 AI」新增該群組，或用「修正」從 OMSI 2 本身的地圖複製（若它們有的話）。

column1: A stop of the timetable that no trip calls at. Nothing is wrong, it is only not used yet.
column2: 時刻表中沒有班次停靠的車站。並無問題，只是尚未使用。

column1: A chrono scenario takes away, retypes or relabels something that is no longer on the map (it was deleted or its IDCode changed): that change does nothing. Open Map > Chrono scenarios, the scenario's properties, and take the change out.
column2: 時空場景取走、重新設定類型或重新命名地圖上已不存在的內容（它已被刪除或 IDCode 已改變）：該變更不會生效。請開啟「地圖 > 時空場景」、場景的屬性，並移除該變更。

column1: A tile holds far more objects than the stock maps' tiles (up to some 600): the game may stutter when it loads it or looks across it. Thin out a wood planted too densely (Plant brush, Clear) or plant it with more space between the trees.
column2: 某圖塊的物件遠多於預設地圖的圖塊（可達約 600 個）：遊戲載入或跨越檢視時可能會卡頓。請減少過密的樹林（種植畫筆、清除），或種植時讓樹木之間保持較大間距。

column1: Street lamps stand on a tile the game does not light from its lamps ([variable_terrainlightmap] is off): at night the ground under them stays dark (unless the tile's light map file was made by OMSI 2's editor). "Fix" turns it on, as on nearly every tile of the stock maps.
column2: 街燈所在的圖塊，遊戲不會以燈具為其照明（[variable_terrainlightmap] 關閉）：夜間其下方地面保持黑暗（除非該圖塊的光照貼圖檔由 OMSI 2 編輯器產生）。可用「修正」開啟，與預設地塊幾乎每一個相同。

column1: An object takes its state ([varparent]) from an object no longer on the map: a signal head stays dark, a display blank. Link it to another in its properties (Linked objects), or "Fix" forgets the link.
column2: 物件從地圖上已不存在的物件取得狀態（[varparent]）：訊號燈頭會保持熄滅，顯示屏空白。可在其屬性中連結至其他物件（「連結物件」），或用「修正」忘記該連結。

column1: A traffic light's signal head takes its light from a crossing's program ([varparent]); this one is linked to none while others like it are, so it stays dark in the game. Select it and link it in its properties (Linked objects).
column2: 交通燈的訊號燈頭從路口的程式取得燈光（[varparent]）；此燈頭未連結任何路口（其他同類燈頭則有），因此在遊戲中保持熄滅。請選取它並在屬性中連結（「連結物件」）。

column1: A depot file (.hof) gives the buses their destinations, the stop names on their displays and the routes their IBIS knows. Without one the signs stay empty and the IBIS knows no line. "Fix" makes it from the map's lines, or adds what the lines need to the map's own (Map > Depot files to see and change it).
column2: 車廠檔案（.hof）為巴士提供終點、顯示屏上的站名，以及其 IBIS 所知的路線。沒有它，顯示牌會保持空白，IBIS 也不會知道任何路線。可用「修正」由地圖的路線建立，或將路線所需的內容加入地圖自身的檔案（見「地圖 > 車廠檔案」以查看及更改）。

column1: A signal route names a signal or track pieces no longer on the map: the signal may never clear. Open Map > Signal routes and take the track again, or delete the route.
column2: 訊號路線指向地圖上已不存在的訊號或軌道段：該訊號可能永遠不會解除。請開啟「地圖 > 訊號路線」重新選取軌道，或刪除該路線。

column1: How the map changes over the years: each scenario from its first day lays its own tiles, lines and tickets over the map. The view shows the map as on the day chosen here; what you edit is always the map itself.
column2: 地圖隨年份的變化：每個場景由其首日起將自己的圖塊、路線與車票覆蓋在地圖上。畫面顯示的是此處所選日期的地圖；你編輯的一向是地圖本身。

column2: 於所示日期開始、在其他場景之後的場景

column2: 變更的內容（顯示於選擇日期之處）

column2: 由其首日起，畫面中的選取：

column2: 從地圖移入場景：由場景首日起便存在（請先放置，再按此）

column2: 留在地圖中，但由場景首日起消失

Written into the scenario at once (undo does not take it out of the scenario).
column2: 即時寫入場景（撤銷不會將其從場景移除）。

column2: 離開場景進入地圖本身：每日都在

column1: Take it out of the scenario
Its own things are on the map: select, move, change and place as usual. The map's own things stay the map's.
column2: 其自有內容在地圖上：可照常選取、移動、更改及放置。地圖本身的內容仍屬地圖。

column1: Edit its own things on the map
column2: 在地圖上編輯其自有內容

column1: What it brings in is put on the map to work with as with anything else; Done writes it back (undo starts afresh)
column2: 它帶入的內容會放在地圖上，像其他內容一樣處理；按「完成」會寫回（撤銷會重新開始）

column1: The Lines window shows its timetable (the map's with its own laid over): lines, trips and tours edited there are the scenario's; a line of the map taken away is taken off from its day.
column2: 「路線」視窗顯示其時刻表（地圖的時刻表上疊加其自有者）：在該處編輯的路線、班次與行車周期屬於場景；地圖的路線若被移除，亦會從該日取消。

column1: Its own lines, trips and tours in the Lines window; Done writes only what differs from the map's (undo starts afresh)
column2: 其自有路線、班次與行車周期位於「路線」視窗；按「完成」只會寫入與地圖不同的部分（撤銷會重新開始）

column1: The Traffic window shows its AI lists (the map's with its own added): vehicles and type groups added there, and a depot's own depot file, are the scenario's from its day.
column2: 「交通」視窗顯示其 AI 清單（地圖的加上其自有的）：在該處新增的車輛與類型群組，以及車廠的自有車廠檔案，由該日起屬於場景。

column1: Vehicles it adds to the groups and depots (OMSI's ailists_#upd.cfg); taking one away is the map's own business
column2: 它加入群組與車廠的車輛（OMSI 的 ailists_#upd.cfg）；移除車輛則屬地圖本身的事務

column1: The map has no chrono scenarios.
The streets of the map's place built as roads with junctions where they meet, its bus stops, lines, trees and woods. Best on tiles with no roads yet: roads lying on ones the map has are left out.
column2: 將地圖所在地的街道建成道路，並在交會處建立路口，以及其巴士站、路線、樹木與樹林。最適合用於尚未有道路的圖塊：與地圖已有道路重疊者會被略去。

column1: The map does not lie on the Earth yet: place it in Satellite and terrain (Map menu, I) first.
column2: 地圖尚未定位到地球：請先在「衛星與地形」（地圖選單，I）中定位。

column1: Load the terrain heights first (Satellite and terrain): the roads follow the ground as it is when they are built.
column2: 請先載入地形高度（衛星與地形）：道路會依建造時的地面起伏而定。

column2: 在「道路」工具的目錄中所選的道路類型

column1: The stop chosen in Game logic > Bus stops
column2: 在「遊戲邏輯 > 巴士站」中所選的車站

column1: Each bus route through two or more of the map's stops a trip of its line, the way found along the roads; a tour from 06:00 to 22:00 for each new line
column2: 每條經過地圖兩個或以上車站的巴士路線，都成為其路線的一個班次，路徑沿道路尋找；每條新路線都有一個由 06:00 至 22:00 的行車周期

column1: Single trees, rows of them and woods, planted with the plant mix (Objects tool > Plant brush) or the tree chosen; none on a road
column2: 單棵樹木、成排的樹木及樹林，以種植組合（「物件」工具 > 種植畫筆」）或所選的樹木種植；道路上不會有樹木

column1: Each outline filled with the model of the folder chosen whose ground plan comes nearest, its front to the nearest road; an outline no model fits is left out
column2: 每個輪廓以所選資料夾中平面圖最接近的模型填滿，正面朝向最近的道路；沒有合適模型的輪廓會被略去
